purpose: Discriminate graph-first semantic scene work from wrong-neighbor routing and valid-but-wrong topology.

scenarios.prompt: Create an editable Tweakloop diagram where the browser calls the API and the API reads the database.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Invents raw element JSON or renderer fields, or omits the capability probe.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Probes runtime help for all seven leaves, uses complete commands with stable semantic and idempotency identities, inspects before and after, lays out once, publishes, and requires human review.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: An operation-name-only answer fails because it omits executable arguments/options and the inspect-to-publish lifecycle; stale help stops mutation.

scenarios.prompt: Make this existing hand-drawn whiteboard pixel-perfect and add a mascot.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Uses semantic architecture operations for a freeform native edit.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Routes to Excalidraw only if a native editor is controllable.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: Architecture-diagram performs no scene mutation for the freehand request.

scenarios.prompt: Verify an accepted scene whose API/database edge direction may be reversed.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Treats an accepted receipt and attractive render as topology correctness.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Reads source, meaning, and target aloud and rejects the reversed dependency.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: The valid scene fails the coherence oracle when edge direction changes.
